name: Senior Software Engineer: Ticket to Green
description: Ingest a ticket, write plan.md, implement with in-step harness iteration (develop, test, self-assess, correct), run automated project/security/UI gates, and close with evidence.
kickoff:
Start the "Senior Software Engineer: Ticket to Green" loop.
Goal: linked ticket is implemented, validated, cleaned up, and evidence-backed
Max iterations: 8
Between iterations run: project safety nets, secret/security audit, and UI/product QA
Exit when: plan.md is attached to the ticket, acceptance criteria are met, automated gates are green, and the result packet explains why the ticket is green
Step 1: Ingest the ticket, board, lane, project, linked files, acceptance criteria, and prior workflow context before planning.
The orchestrator explains the run and starts the harness after you confirm. Each harness step iterates internally: develop → test → self-assess → correct → report back.
Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

Guardrails (do not skip):
- Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
- Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
- If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics

steps.name: Ingest ticket and project context
steps.instruction: Read the linked ticket title, description, comments, board, lane, project, todos, linked files, acceptance criteria, recommended skills, and any prior result-packet context. Restate the problem, constraints, risks, missing information, and the project route that should own the work. Report using the harness return contract so the orchestrator can record this on the workflow run.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Do not write code before the plan artifact exists
failure_checklist: Ticket acceptance criteria were not restated
Project route or linked project context was not identified
steps.validation_prompt: Ticket brief, acceptance criteria, risks, project route, and context handoff are explicit.

steps.name: Write plan.md and attach to ticket
steps.instruction: Create or update a ticket-specific plan.md artifact in the project. Include requirements, implementation slices, affected files, tests to write before shipping, security checks, UI checks, rollback plan, data cleanup plan, and eval scoring criteria. Attach or link plan.md back to the ticket before implementation. Report using the harness return contract.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- The plan must be tied to this ticket, not a generic checklist
failure_checklist: plan.md missing or not linked to ticket
Plan lacks tests, rollback, cleanup, security, UI, or eval criteria
Plan omits context transferred from the ticket
steps.validation_prompt: plan.md exists, is linked or attached to the ticket, and includes tests, rollback, cleanup, security, UI, and eval criteria.

steps.name: Implement, test, and self-correct
steps.instruction: Implement the next planned slice using the project conventions. Inside this step, iterate before reporting: develop the change → run the project's real lint/test/build commands → self-assess for scope drift, security basics, illogical UI, and regression risk → correct failures → report using the harness return contract. The orchestrator stores improvements on the workflow run; the human steers through the workflow, not by micro-managing sub-tasks in the editor.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Detect commands from the actual project config before running them
- Do not assume npm, pytest, or make unless the repo proves it
- Do not bypass tests or weaken acceptance criteria
failure_checklist: No test or eval coverage for changed behavior
Implementation drifts outside the ticket plan
Drift, security, or UI issues were not self-assessed
Harness report missing tests, drift check, or self-corrections
steps.validation_prompt: Planned slice is implemented, tested, self-assessed, and reported with a complete harness return contract.

steps.name: Run project and security gates
steps.instruction: Run discovered lint/test/build commands, then the secret/security audit. Capture exact commands and output. If any gate fails, the workflow routes back to implementation.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Detect commands from the actual project config before running them
- Do not assume npm, pytest, or make unless the repo proves it
- Do not edit commands, tests, or configs just to force green
steps.validation_prompt: Discovered lint/test/build safety nets and secret audit exit 0 in the linked project folder.
steps.command:
set -eu
if [ -f package.json ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cmd=$(node -e "const p=require('./package.json').scripts||{}; const cmds=[]; if(p.lint) cmds.push('npm run lint'); if(p.test) cmds.push('npm test'); if(p.build) cmds.push('npm run build'); console.log(cmds.join(' && '));")
  if [ -n "$cmd" ]; then
    echo "$cmd"
    sh -lc "$cmd"
    exit $?
  fi
fi
if [ -f pyproject.toml ] || [ -d tests ]; then
  if command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pytest -q
  else
    python3 -m pytest -q
  fi
  exit $?
fi
if [ -f Makefile ]; then
  make test
  exit $?
fi
echo "No project safety net command discovered; add lint/test/build command to the ticket plan." >&2
exit 2
echo '--- security audit ---'
set -eu
if ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Not a git worktree; cannot prove tracked secret safety." >&2
  exit 2
fi
tracked_secret_files=$(git ls-files | grep -E '(^|/)(\.env($|\.)|.*\.(pem|key|p12|pfx)$)' || true)
if [ -n "$tracked_secret_files" ]; then
  echo "Secret-like files are tracked:"
  echo "$tracked_secret_files"
  exit 1
fi
hardcoded=$(git grep -n -E '(api[_-]?key|secret|password|token)[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*"[^"]{12,}"' -- . ':!vendor' ':!node_modules' ':!*.lock' || true)
if [ -n "$hardcoded" ]; then
  echo "Hard-coded secret candidates:"
  echo "$hardcoded"
  exit 1
fi
echo 'Secret and environment audit passed.'

steps.name: Verify UI and product behavior
steps.instruction: Use Playwright/browser-use against the affected local or staging UI. Check changed flows, visible controls, loading and error states, responsive layout, console errors, and whether the UI logically matches the ticket. Capture evidence the orchestrator can attach to the result packet.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Do not accept hidden required actions, clipped text, or rogue UI controls
failure_checklist: Changed flow not exercised in browser
Console errors, visual drift, or nonsensical UI ignored
steps.validation_prompt: Browser evidence proves the changed UI flow makes sense, works, and has no console or visual blockers.

steps.name: Close ticket with evidence
steps.instruction: Evaluate whether all gates are green: plan.md attached, acceptance criteria met, automated checks passed, cleanup done, and the result packet is complete. Update the ticket with changed files, commands run, browser evidence, security notes, and the final summary. Mark the workflow complete only after this ticket-facing evidence is written.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Do not mark green with unresolved blockers or missing evidence
failure_checklist: Ticket was not updated with evidence
Exit declared with failing tests, security, or UI gate
Final result packet does not explain why the run is green
steps.validation_prompt: Ticket contains the final evidence summary, result packet, and closure status.
